name: Neige Owleyes
original_name: ネージュ＝オウルアイズ
source: A 'wither' elf, elves who have severed their ties to nature. Neige is a researcher and counselor of the magician's guild devoted to the knowledge of new magic. She is one of the most preeminent wielders of magic in the kingdom, but she seldom shows herself in public.
